settings.languageHint: Applies immediately in this browser; not included in server settings exports.
settings.languageScope: Core screens support English and Vietnamese. Other feature pages and server diagnostics may remain in English. Operating-system startup integration is a separate feature.
common.emptyHint: Connect a provider or change the current filters to see results.
common.loadHint: Check the gateway connection and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach AIGate. Check that the server is running, then try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: AIGate did not answer within {seconds} seconds. Try again.
errors.BAD_RESPONSE: AIGate returned a response the dashboard could not read. Refresh the page.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS_COUNT: The password did not match. {count} attempt(s) left before a temporary lock.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many failed attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_TIME: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {seconds}s.
errors.NOT_LOCAL: Set the first password on the machine running AIGate, or start AIGate with AIGATE_INITIAL_PASSWORD.
errors.ALREADY_SET_UP: A dashboard password already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.LIMIT_REACHED: You have reached the maximum of 100 API keys. Revoke one you no longer use.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That item no longer exists. The list was refreshed.
errors.CONFLICT: That resource already exists. Choose another name.
errors.SETTINGS_CHANGED: Settings changed since your import preview. Preview the document again before applying it.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The relay provider could not complete this deployment. Try again.
errors.PROVIDER_NOT_SUPPORTED: This provider cannot be connected yet.
errors.ALREADY_CONNECTED: This provider is already connected. Use Replace key on its row instead.
errors.CREDENTIAL_UNREADABLE: The saved key can no longer be decrypted, because the secret key file changed. Use Replace key to enter it again.
errors.MODELS_FETCH_FAILED: Failed to fetch models. Test the connection to see why.
errors.MODELS_DETAIL: {message}. Test the connection to see why.
errors.NO_ACTIVE_CONNECTION: Add or enable a provider connection to hear this voice.
errors.VOICES_FETCH_FAILED: The provider's voice list could not be loaded. Check the connection's key, then retry.
errors.VOICES_DETAIL: {message} Check the connection's key, then retry.
errors.VOICE_PREVIEW_FAILED: The provider could not generate a voice preview.
errors.USAGE_STREAM_BUSY: Live usage updates are off: too many dashboard tabs are watching usage. Close another tab, then reload this page.
errors.USAGE_STREAM_DISCONNECTED: The live usage connection closed. Reconnect to resume live updates; the last received rows are historical.
errors.LOG_STREAM_BUSY: Live console updates are off: all eight log streams are in use. Close another dashboard tab and reload this page.
errors.TUNNEL_SECURITY_REQUIRED: Secure dashboard login and API keys before enabling a public tunnel.
errors.TUNNEL_ROUTE_CONFLICT: Another Tailscale Funnel route is active. Review it before enabling AIGate.
errors.TUNNEL_NOT_INSTALLED: Install and sign in to Tailscale on the AIGate host before enabling Funnel.
errors.TUNNEL_START_FAILED: Tailscale Funnel could not start. Check the Tailscale daemon and tailnet Funnel policy.
errors.TUNNEL_STOP_FAILED: Tailscale Funnel could not be disabled. Check the Tailscale daemon and retry.
errors.NODE_LIMIT: You have reached the maximum of 100 custom providers. Delete one you no longer use.
errors.PROXY_POOL_IN_USE: This proxy pool is still assigned to a connection. Remove it from those connections first.
errors.COMBO_EXISTS: A combo with this name already exists. Choose another name, or edit that combo.
errors.COMBO_LIMIT: You have reached the maximum of 200 combos. Delete one you no longer use.
errors.UNEXPECTED: Something went wrong in the dashboard. Refresh the page.
errors.HTTP_SERVER: AIGate hit an unexpected error (HTTP {status}). Try again; if it keeps happening, check the server log.
